description: State and audit quality canon for ensuring project state integrity.

quality_dimensions.name: Artifact Index Consistency
quality_dimensions.description: artifact_index.json must be internally consistent and match filesystem.
quality_dimensions.acceptance_criteria: All referenced artifacts exist. No contradictory flags.
quality_dimensions.rejection_criteria: Missing artifacts, contradictory state flags, or stale references.

quality_dimensions.name: Ledger Consistency
quality_dimensions.description: episode_ledger.json events must form a coherent timeline.
quality_dimensions.acceptance_criteria: Events in chronological order. State transitions logical.
quality_dimensions.rejection_criteria: Impossible state transitions or missing events.

quality_dimensions.name: Git Cleanliness
quality_dimensions.description: Git working directory must be clean at gate checkpoints.
quality_dimensions.acceptance_criteria: No uncommitted changes. All expected files committed.

quality_dimensions.name: Proof Completeness
quality_dimensions.description: Required proof artifacts must be present for each completed layer.
quality_dimensions.acceptance_criteria: Every completed layer has corresponding proof JSON.
quality_dimensions.rejection_criteria: Missing proof for a completed layer.
